- Documentation and usage remain unchanged.

Initial release: Provides comprehensive Douyin (抖音) account data diagnosis via Redfox API.

- Supports four-dimensional scoring (account scale, content performance, operation activity, platform index) with 100-point scale.
- Generates detailed scoring breakdown and full diagnosis report with strengths, weaknesses, and targeted optimization suggestions.
- Allows searches by Douyin nickname (fuzzy) or account ID (exact).
- Handles null values gracefully and ensures strict data traceability (no estimation or invention).
- Includes clear fallback and user instructions for API failures or missing data.
